simple.meaning: זָמִיר (zâmîyr) is a Hebrew concept word meaning “a song to be accompanied with instrumental music.” BibleIQ follows how Scripture develops this idea across its occurrences.
simple.biblicalBackground: The concept appears 6 times across 2 Samuel, Job, Psalms, Isaiah, beginning at 2 Samuel 23:1. Its contexts include family line, righteousness.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to זָמִיר (H2158).
simple.whyItMatters: Concept words shape biblical themes. BibleIQ keeps the concept grounded in actual verse evidence instead of starting with a later theological definition.

definitions.short: a song to be accompanied with instrumental music
definitions.full: H2158. zamir I. [ זָמִיר ] noun masculine Isa 25:5 song (compare Ba NB 136 ) — construct זְמִיר 25:5 ; plural absolute זְמִרוֺת Job 35:10 2 t., זְמִרֹת Isa 24:16 ; construct זְמִרוֺת 2Sam 23:1 ; — song ישׂראל זְמִרוֺת נְעִים 23:1 in epithet of David; Job 35:10 ; Isa 24:16 ; of (hostile) Songs of triumph עָרִיצִים זְמִיר 25:5 (|| זָרִים שְׁאוֺן ); song in praise of לוֺ נָרִיעָה בִּזְמִרוֺת ׳י Psa 95:2 (|| תודה ), compare ׳ז חֻקֶּיךָ לי היו 119:54 , i.e. they are the subject of my song. — On Song 2:12 see II. זמיר below II. זמר .

occurrences.englishText: Now these are the last words of David.
But no one says, ‘Where is God my Maker,
Let’s come before his presence with thanksgiving.
Your statutes have been my songs
From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs. Glory to the righteous!
As the heat in a dry place you will bring down the noise of strangers; as the heat by the shade of a cloud, the song of the dreaded ones will be brought low.
